author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ततः किं जातमिति धार्तराष्ट्रहार्दं परिहर्तुं सञ्जय उवाच किमित्यत आह ॥ एतदित्यादिना। वेपमानः भयकम्पिताङ्गः । भीतभीतः अत्यन्तभीतः ॥ ११.३५॥
translation: Sanjaya said: Having heard this word of Krishna with joined hands; Kiriti, trembling, bowed down again, spoke to Krishna in a faltering voice, very much terrified and bowing. (35)
